blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.
blocks.zh: 多语种评价基准是评估大语文模式是否普遍超过英语的主要工具,但这些基准是否充分尚未得到系统的审查。 我们提出对涵盖242个数据集和219个语言的51个最近多语种基准进行的数据驱动审计,围绕三个支柱:覆盖面、代表性和严格度。 整个地区(大洋洲、美洲、中亚)几乎为零, 任务公平差距严重, 低资源语言在1-3任务类别上被评价, 而高资源语言则只有14个。 代表性在结构上受到影响:英文翻译仍然是主要的构建战略,其中56%的数据集语言实例被翻译引进了文物和以英语为中心的框架,而基于文化的内容则集中在少数由社区驱动、语言范围狭窄的基准上。 因此,生态系统迫使在宽度和有效性之间取舍。 由于基准污染,包括翻译基准泄漏和避免地表形态检测的平行实体重叠,使严格度受损。 我们将这些结论综合为具体建议,以建立以本土建设、基于文化、了解污染情况并旨在为其声称评价其语言的社区服务的评价框架。 收集的所有元数据的仪表板可在https://aka.ms/multi-evals上找到。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument through which the NLP community measures progress. AI evaluation is critical beyond English, particularly for Global South languages, because most AI systems are designed from an English-centric perspective, with Global North assumptions baked into their data, task design, and notions of success ( Akindotuni, 2025 ; Lamentillo, 2025 ) . Benchmark gains on English can obscure systematic failures in other languages and conditions where AI systems are deployed, potentially leading to marginalized communities being excluded, stereotyped, or exposed to high-stakes failures ( Lachini, 2024 ; Ahmad et al., 2025 ) . Multilingual evaluation for Large Language Models (LLMs) has expanded rapidly in recent years, reflecting a growing recognition that English-only evaluation is insufficient ( Weidinger et al., 2022 ; Mergen et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Upadhayay, 2025 ; Kargaran et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . However, multilingual evaluation is not simply about measuring in another language what is measured in English, but about capturing the local contexts and cultural nuances that determine quality, usefulness and safety. Recently at the India AI Impact Summit 1 1 1 https://impact.indiaai.gov.in/ , the New Delhi Frontier AI Commitments make this explicit through the commitment titled ‘‘Strengthening Multilingual and Contextual Evaluations,’’ which calls for ensuring AI system effectiveness ‘‘across languages, cultures, and real-world use cases’’ 2 2 2 https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2230201 .
blocks.zh: 评价基准是NLP社区衡量进展的主要工具。 AI评价在英语之外至关重要,特别是对于全球南方语言而言,因为大多数AI系统都是从以英语为中心的角度设计的,其数据、任务设计和成功概念都融入了全球北方的假设(Akindotuni,2025;Lamentillo,2025)。 关于英语的基准进展可以掩盖使用人工智能系统的其他语言和条件的系统性失败,可能导致边缘化社区被排斥、定型化或暴露在高考失败中(Lachini, 2024年;Ahmad等人,2025年)。 近年来,大语言模型(LLM)的多种语言评价迅速扩大,反映出人们日益认识到,仅英语评价是不够的(Weidinger等人,2022年;Mergen等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年;Upadhayy,2025年;Kargaran等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年)。 然而,多语种评价不仅仅是用另一种语言衡量用英语衡量的内容,而是了解决定质量、有用性和安全性的地方背景和文化细微差别。 最近在印度AI影响峰会上,1 1 https://impact.indiaai.gov.in/,新德里边境AI承诺通过题为“加强多种语言和背景评价”的承诺明确了这一点,其中要求确保AI系统的有效性—— 跨越语言、文化和现实世界使用案例—— 2 2 2 https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2230201。

blocks.en:
Progress on multilingual evaluation remains limited in important ways ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Sinha et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , with many efforts still being Western-centric in their assumptions, priorities, and task formulations, often extending English benchmarks to other languages rather than grounding evaluation in the linguistic, cultural, and practical realities of diverse communities ( Smith, 2025 ; Oh et al., 2025 ; Mushtaq et al., 2025 ; Zahraei and Asgari, 2025 ; Plum et al., 2025 ) . As a result, existing benchmarks are often not broad enough in the languages, varieties, and tasks they cover, nor sufficiently representative of how people actually use language technologies in different contexts ( McIntosh et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . In the spirit of Joshi et al. (2020) ”The State and Fate of Linguistic Diversity and Inclusion in the NLP World”, which took stock of languages represented in NLP and ones that are left behind, we offer a similar reckoning for multilingual evaluation by examining its growth and gaps. We examine the current state of multilingual LLM evaluation through three key lenses: coverage, representativeness, and rigor, identify limitations in current practice and outline directions for building evaluation frameworks that are more meaningful, valid, and globally relevant.
We will release all structured metadata annotations, the full analysis codebase, and an interactive web dashboard that will allow users to explore benchmark coverage, representativeness, and per-language statistics (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
多语种评价的进展在重要方面仍然有限(Wu等人,2025年;Sinha等人,2025年;Qin等人,2025年),许多努力在假设、优先事项和任务拟订方面仍然是以西方为中心的,往往将英语基准扩大到其他语言,而不是将评价建立在不同社区的语言、文化和实际现实上(Smith等人,2025年;Oh等人,2025年;Mushtaq等人,2025年;Zahraei和Asgari,2025年;Plum等人,2025年)。 因此,现有基准在所涵盖语言、品种和任务方面往往不够广泛,也不足以反映人们在不同背景下如何实际使用语言技术(McIntosh等人,2025年;Ni等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年)。 本着Joshi等人(2020年)的精神,“NLP世界语言多样性和包容的现状和命运”总结了NLP所代表的语言和遗留下来的语言,我们通过审查其增长和差距,对多语种评价提出类似的考虑。 我们通过三个关键视角审查多语种LLM评价的现状:覆盖面、代表性和严谨性,查明目前做法的局限性,并概述建立更有意义、有效和具有全球相关性的评价框架的方向。
我们将发布所有结构化的元数据说明、完整的分析编码库和交互式网络仪表板,使用户能够探索基准覆盖范围、代表性和每种语言的统计数据(附录C)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early cross-lingual benchmarks such as XNLI ( Conneau et al., 2018 ) established the paradigm of translating English datasets into multiple languages to perform multilingual evaluation. This was scaled across dozens of languages and task types by large benchmarking efforts such as XTREME-R, XGLUE, and MEGA ( Ruder et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2020 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ) . However, language coverage remains heavily skewed toward high-resource Indo-European and CJK languages ( Joshi et al., 2020 ; Blasi et al., 2022 ; Conneau et al., 2020 ; Ruder et al., 2021 ) , and low-resource languages continue to lag behind ( Ahuja et al., 2023 ; Asai et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . LLM-powered data augmentation for multilingual commonsense reasoning also fails to produce meaningful text in certain low-resource languages ( Doostmohammadi, 2026 ; Gain et al., 2025 ) . Furthermore, multilingual LLMs have been shown to use English as an internal pivot, with abstract representations closer to English than to other input languages, revealing a structural English-centrism that needs to be addressed in evaluation ( Wendler et al., 2024 ; Ye, 2025 ; Blasi et al., 2022 ; Kumar et al., 2025 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ) . These limitations have prompted calls for alternative paradigms such as performance prediction over per-language evaluation sets ( Ahuja et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: XNLI(Conneau et al., 2018)等早期跨语言基准建立了将英语数据集翻译成多种语言进行多语言评价的范例. 通过XTREME-R、XGLUE和MEGA(Ruder等人,2021年;Liang等人,2020年;Ahuja等人,2023年)等大型基准工作,这在数十种语言和任务类型中得到了推广。 然而,语言覆盖面仍然严重偏差于高资源型印欧语和CJK语(Joshi等人,2020年;Blasi等人,2022年;Conneau等人,2020年;Ruder等人,2021年),低资源型语言继续落后(Ahuja等人,2023年;Asai等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年). 多语言常识推理的LLM动力数据增强也未能以某些低资源型语言产生有意义的文本(Doostmohammadi,2026年;Gaine等人,2025年)。 此外,多种语言的LLMs被证明是使用英语作为内部中枢,抽象表述比其他输入语言更接近英语,揭示了一种结构性的英语中心论,需要在评价中加以解决(Wendler等人,2024年;Ye,2025年;Blasi等人,2022年;Kumar等人,2025年;Ahuja等人,2023年)。 这些限制促使人们呼吁采用替代范式,如对每套语言评价进行业绩预测(Ahuja等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: A critical concern with multilingual benchmarks is their reliance on translation from English ( Huang et al., 2025a ) , as exemplified by XNLI’s use of professionally translated MultiNLI data ( Conneau et al., 2018 ) . TyDiQA ( Clark et al., 2020 ) addressed this by eliciting questions directly in each target language, avoiding translationese 3 3 3 Translationese refers to unnatural linguistic patterns arising from translation that fail to reflect how native speakers naturally express themselves. artifacts and better capturing language-specific information needs. Several studies further highlight how cultural knowledge, pragmatic norms, and world knowledge diverge from the English-centric assumptions embedded in translated datasets ( Hershcovich et al., 2022 ; Ruder et al., 2021 ; Conneau et al., 2018 ; Hou et al., 2026 ; Ebrahimi et al., 2022 ; Wendler et al., 2024 ) . Language-specific benchmarks such as MasakhaNER, IndicNLPSuite, AmericasNLI, and NusaX have shown that culturally grounded evaluation yields substantially different performance profiles than translated counterparts ( Adelani et al., 2021 ; Kakwani et al., 2020 ; Ebrahimi et al., 2022 ; Winata et al., 2023 ) . However, even these benchmarks do not always reflect the priorities or lived realities of the communities they target. Community-driven efforts like Pariksha ( Watts et al., 2024 ) and Samiksha ( Bhat et al., 2025 ) help bridge this gap by incorporating stakeholder input, though such benchmarks remain scarce. More recently, benchmarks like TUMLU ( Isbarov et al., 2025 ) for Turkic languages have begun prioritizing sociolinguistic authenticity over mere cross-lingual alignment.
blocks.zh: 多语种基准的一个关键关注是它们依赖英语翻译(Huang等人,2025年a),例如XNLI使用专业翻译的MultiNLI数据(Conneau等人,2018年)。 泰迪卡 (Clark et al., 2020)通过在每种目标语言中直接引出问题来解决这一问题,避免翻译 3 3 3 翻译 3 翻译 指翻译过程中产生的不自然的语言模式,未能反映母语人如何自然表达自己. 文物和更好地捕捉特定语言的信息需求。 一些研究进一步突出了文化知识、实用规范和世界知识如何与翻译数据集中嵌入的以英语为中心的假设不同(Hershcovich等人,2022年;Ruder等人,2021年;Conneau等人,2018年;Hou等人,2026年;Ebrahimi等人,2022年;Wendler等人,2024年)。 MasakhaNER、IndicNLPSUTE、AmericanNLI和NusaX等具体语言基准表明,基于文化的评价与翻译的对应方相比,其业绩基本不同(Adelani等人,2021年;Kakwani等人,2020年;Ebrahimi等人,2022年;Winata等人,2023年)。 然而,即使这些基准也并不总是反映它们所针对社区的优先事项或现实。 Pariksha(Watts等人,2024年)和Samiksha等社区驱动的努力 (Bhat等人,2025年)通过吸收利益攸关方的投入帮助弥补这一差距,尽管这些基准仍然很少。 最近,突厥语的TUMLU(Isbarov等人,2025年)等基准开始优先考虑社会语言的真实性,而不是单纯的跨语言对齐。

blocks.en: The integrity of benchmark-based evaluation has come under increasing scrutiny as LLMs are trained on ever-larger web corpora that may include benchmark test data. Contamination has been argued to represent an existential threat to LLM evaluation, necessitating systematic analysis before conclusions are drawn from benchmark results ( Ahuja et al., 2024b ; Sainz et al., 2023 ; Jacovi et al., 2023 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ) . Practical mitigation strategies have been proposed, including encrypting test data and demanding training exclusion controls from closed API model builders to proactively protect test data rather than retroactively detect leakage ( Jacovi et al., 2023 ; Sainz et al., 2023 ; Blasi et al., 2022 ) . The problem is further complicated by the opacity of training data in proprietary models, where contamination can only be inferred indirectly ( Sainz et al., 2023 ; Jacovi et al., 2023 ; Casalnuovo and Farrell, 2025 ) and agentic behavior showing evidence of knowledge of being tested 4 4 4 https://www.nist.gov/caisi/cheating-ai-agent-evaluations and deliberate cheating 5 5 5 https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/eval-awareness-browsecomp . In the multilingual setting, contamination risks are compounded by the existence of parallel corpora and translated benchmark variants: a model trained on English test data may exhibit inflated performance on translated versions in other languages, yet this cross-lingual leakage pathway remains poorly characterized ( Sainz et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2020 ; Ruder et al., 2021 ; Conneau et al., 2018 ; Cruz and Aji, 2026 ) . Contamination detection methods trained on one language often fail to generalize to linguistically dissimilar languages ( Macko et al., 2023 ) and usually rely on surface-form overlap, which is inadequate for detecting semantic leakage through paraphrase or translation ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Macko et al., 2023 ; Blevins and Zettlemoyer, 2022 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Cruz and Aji, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 以基准为基础的评价的完整性受到越来越多的审查,因为有限责任公司接受关于规模越来越大的网络公司的培训,其中可能包括基准测试数据。 污染被认为对LLM评价构成存在性威胁,在从基准结果中得出结论之前必须进行系统分析(Ahuja等人,2024b;Sainz等人,2023年;Jacovi等人,2023年;Ahuja等人,2023年)。 提出了实际的缓解战略,包括加密测试数据,要求封闭的API模型构建者对培训排除控制进行主动保护测试数据,而不是追溯检测渗漏(Jacovi等人,2023年;Sainz等人,2023年;Blasi等人,2022年)。 专利模型的培训数据不透明,只能间接推断污染(Sainz等人,2023年;Jacovi等人,2023年;Casalnuovo and Farrell,2025年),以及显示对试验知识的证据的代理行为,使这一问题更加复杂。 在多语种环境中,由于存在平行的corporora和翻译基准变体,污染风险更为严重:一个受过英语测试数据培训的模型在其他语言翻译版本上可能表现出夸大的表现,然而这种跨语言的渗漏路径仍然特征不佳(Sainz等人,2023年;Liang等人,2020年;Ruder等人,2021年;Conneau等人,2018年;Cruz和Aji,2026年)。 接受过一种语言培训的污染检测方法往往无法概括到语言上不同的语言(Macko等人,2023年),通常依赖表面形态重叠,不足以通过解释或翻译来检测语义渗漏(Cheng等人,2025年;Macko等人,2023年;Brevins和Zettlemoyer,2022年;Fu等人,2025年;Cruz和Aji,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Survey of Existing Multilingual Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 3 现有多种语文基准调查

blocks.en: We conduct a unified audit of existing multilingual benchmarks across coverage, representativeness, and rigor in four stages: benchmark collection, structured field extraction, manual verification, and contamination checks.
blocks.zh: 我们分四个阶段,对涵盖范围、代表性和严格程度的现有多语种基准进行统一审计:基准收集、结构化实地提取、人工核查和污染检查。

blocks.en: We compile a corpus of 51 publicly released multilingual evaluation benchmarks, spanning diverse tasks (NLI, QA, NER, sentiment analysis, commonsense reasoning, summarization, and others), language resource levels, and language families. We identify candidate benchmarks through a combination of literature search, leaderboard tracking, and community repositories. We include both widely cited benchmarks (e.g., XNLI, XQuAD, TyDiQA) and recent community-driven efforts targeting underrepresented languages and regions (e.g., AfriSenti, MasakhaNER, IrokoBench). The full list is provided in Table 8 . For fine-grained analysis, each benchmark must be annotated with a consistent set of structured fields, including languages covered, language families, scripts, task types, construction methodology (translated vs. natively authored), data sources, and licensing information. To extract these fields at scale, we leverage Claude Opus 4.6 6 6 6 https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-6 , prompting the model with the benchmark’s paper and metadata as context. The extraction methodology is provided in the Appendix A.1 . This semi-automated approach enables consistent, structured annotation across all 51 benchmarks while substantially reducing manual effort. We then perform a thorough manual verification of the annotations by cross-referencing the extracted fields with the original papers, dataset cards, and associated repositories.
blocks.zh: 我们汇编了51个公开发布的多语种评价基准,涉及各种任务(NLI、QA、NER、情绪分析、常识推理、总结等)、语言资源水平和语言家庭。 我们通过文献搜索、领导板跟踪和社区储存库等综合方法确定候选基准。 我们既包括广泛引用的基准(如XNLI、XuAD、TyDiQA),也包括最近针对代表性不足的语言和区域(如非洲荷兰语、Masakhaner、Iroko Bench)的社区驱动努力。 完整名单见表8。 对于精细分析,每个基准必须附加一套一致的结构化字段,包括涵盖的语言、语言家族、脚本、任务类型、构建方法(翻译与本土作者)、数据来源和许可证信息。 为了大规模挖掘这些领域,我们利用Claude Opus 4.6 6 6 6 https://www.harmic.com/news/claude-opus-4-6,以基准文件和元数据作为背景推动模型。 提取方法见附录A.1。 这种半自动化方法能够对所有51个基准进行连贯、结构化的说明,同时大大减少人工努力。 然后,我们通过将提取的字段与原始文件、数据集卡和相关寄存器相互参照,对说明进行彻底的人工核查。

blocks.en: 3.1 Coverage
blocks.zh: 3.1 覆盖范围

blocks.en: We analyze 51 benchmarks encompassing 242 distinct datasets and 219 unique languages along four dimensions: language, typological and geographic diversity, task coverage, and resource-level balance. Because many benchmarks aggregate existing datasets (22 of the 51 are mixed or aggregation suites), we conduct our analysis at the dataset–language level to avoid inflating coverage counts when the same dataset appears in multiple benchmarks.Unless otherwise specified, all subsequent analyses are conducted and reported at the dataset level.
blocks.zh: 我们按照四个方面分析51项基准,包括242个不同的数据集和219种独特的语言:语言、类型和地域多样性、任务覆盖范围和资源水平平衡。 由于许多基准汇总了现有的数据集(51个数据集中有22个是混合的或汇总的套件),我们在数据集-语言层面进行分析,以避免当同一数据集出现在多个基准中时夸大覆盖面。 除非另有说明,其后所有分析均在数据集一级进行和报告。

blocks.en: Language Coverage: Across the 51 benchmarks we survey, a total of 219 unique languages are evaluated across 242 datasets, suggesting reasonable coverage. However, the distribution follows a steep power law, as shown in Figure 1 that plots languages ranked by the number of datasets in which they appear. A small cluster of high-resource languages Hindi, Chinese, Spanish, Swahili, Arabic appear in 19 or more datasets, while 48 of 219 languages (37%) appear in only a single dataset . For these 48 languages, there exists no independent replication of evaluation results and no opportunity for cross-dataset comparison. This long-tail structure has a direct methodological implication: claims of multilingual generalization rest on a dense evaluation of a handful of languages and single-point estimates for the majority.
blocks.zh: 语言覆盖面:在我们调查的51个基准中,共有219种独特的语言在242个数据集中得到评价,这表明覆盖面合理。 然而,分布遵循一个陡峭的电源定律,如图1所示,图1按出现语言的数据集数量排序语言. 一小群高资源语言印地语、汉语、西班牙语、斯瓦希里语、阿拉伯语出现在19个或更多的数据集中,而219种语言中有48种(37%)只出现在一个数据集中。 对于这48种语文,没有独立复制评价结果,也没有机会进行交叉数据集比较。 这种长尾结构具有直接的方法含义:多语种通俗化的说法依赖于对少数语言的密集评价和对多数语言的单一点估计。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Languages ranked by the number of datasets in which they appear. The long tail reveals that 36% of evaluated languages appear in only a single dataset .
blocks.zh: 图1:语文按其显示的数据集数排序。 长尾部分显示,36%的评价语言只出现在一个数据集中。

blocks.en: Typological and Geographical Coverage: Language count alone is an insufficient measure of diversity. Two benchmark suites could each cover 20 languages yet differ vastly in typological range if one samples broadly across families and scripts while the other concentrates on closely related Indo-European varieties. Figure 2(a) shows the distribution of unique languages across the 29 language families represented in our survey. Indo-European languages account for 83 of 219 languages (38%) , while Atlantic-Congo (39 languages) ranks second, but this representation is almost entirely attributable to Africa-focused benchmarks like AfroBench, IrokoBench, and Uhuru. Families such as Austroasiatic (3 languages), Tai-Kadai (3), Japonic (1), and Quechuan (2) are poorly represented. The entire Oceanic branch of Austronesian is absent. Figure 2(b) reveals a similar distribution: Latin script accounts for the majority of evaluated languages, followed by Devanagari, Arabic, and CJK. Scripts used by hundreds of millions of speakers such as Ge’ez (Ethiopic), Khmer, Myanmar appear in only 1–3 benchmarks. Script diversity matters because models may exhibit systematically different tokenization efficiency ( Ahia et al., 2023 ) , character-level recall, and decoding accuracy across scripts, and these script-specific failure modes remain invisible when evaluation concentrates on Latin and Devanagari. We find similar trends in Geographical coverage as well with entire regions of the world such as Oceania and South America having very poor or no representation.
blocks.zh: 类型和地理 覆盖面:单靠语言计算不足以衡量多样性。 两个基准套房可以涵盖20种语言,但在类型学范围上却大不相同,如果一个样本在家庭和脚本之间大致相同,而另一个则集中于密切相关的印欧品种。 图2(a)显示了我们调查中29个语言家庭的独特语言分布情况。 在219种语言中,印欧语言占83种(38%),而大西洋-刚果语言(39种)排在第二位,但这一代表性几乎完全归因于非洲本奇、伊罗科本奇和乌胡鲁等以非洲为重点的基准。 澳洲语(3种语言),台卡台语(3种),日语(1种),克川语(2种)等家庭代表率低. 整个奥斯特罗尼西亚的大洋分支都缺席了. 图2(b)显示类似的分布: 拉丁文在被评价的语言中占大多数,其次是德瓦纳加里语,阿拉伯语和CJK语. 缅甸高棉高棉等数亿讲者使用的脚本, 脚本多样性很重要,因为模型可能系统性地表现出不同的象征化效率(Ahia等人,2023年),字符级召回,以及各个脚本的解码精度,这些脚本特有的失败模式在评价集中于拉丁语和德瓦纳加里语时仍然看不见. 我们发现,在地理覆盖范围方面,以及在大洋洲和南美洲等世界所有区域代表性极差或根本没有代表性的情况下,也有类似的趋势。

blocks.en: Resource-Level Distribution and Task Equity: We examine the resource-level composition of evaluated languages using the taxonomy from Joshi et al. (2020) . Across the 242 distinct datasets, 65% of evaluated languages fall in the two lowest resource classes (Scraping-Bys and Left-Behinds, levels 0–1), while Winners (level 5) account for only 5% (Figure 7 in Appendix A.2 ). This distribution appears to favor low-resource languages, but a finer-grained analysis reverses the picture. Figure 3 disaggregates task coverage across 15 categories by resource level: the 10 Winner languages are each evaluated on a median of 14 task categories across multiple benchmarks, whereas the 160 low-resource languages (levels 0–2) are typically tested on only 1–3 tasks in a single benchmark. For Left-Behinds, Translation alone accounts for 29% of all evaluation rows and Sentiment/Classification for 25%, while Coding, Safety/Toxicity, and Instruction Following each represent only 1%. By contrast, Winners and Underdogs distribute evaluation more evenly, with Math/Reasoning (11% and 8%), Embedding/Retrieval (9% and 6%), and Safety (7% and 9%) all receiving meaningful attention. In absolute terms, Safety/Toxicity evaluation is scarce—only roughly 25 dataset–language rows across all datasets—and these are concentrated almost entirely at higher resource levels, meaning that safety coverage for low-resource languages is effectively nonexistent. Figure 8 (Appendix) cross-tabulates task categories against world regions and confirms that QA and knowledge tasks dominate everywhere, while specialized capabilities show uneven coverage. This task equity gap means that for most low-resource languages, a model’s “evaluation” amounts to a narrow probe on translation and classification, making it far too limited to support claims of general competence.
blocks.zh: 资源层面的分配和任务公平: 我们使用Joshi等人(2020年)的分类法来审查评估语言的资源构成。 在242个不同的数据集中,65%的评价语言属于两种最低资源类别(Scraping-Bys和Left-Behinds,0-1级),而胜者(5级)仅占5%(附录A.2图7)。 这种分布似乎倾向于低资源语言,但精细的刻度分析扭转了画面. 图3按资源水平分列了15个类别的任务范围:10种胜方语言按不同基准的14个任务类别中的中位数加以评价,而160种低资源语言(0-2级)通常在一个单一基准中仅测试1-3项任务。 对于左翼后方,仅翻译就占所有评价行的29%,而Sentiment/Classification占25%,而编码、安全/毒性和指令后面各仅占1%。 相比之下,赢家和弱者分配评价更为均匀,数学/重心(11%和8%)、嵌入/检索(9%和6%)和安全(7%和9%)都得到了有意义的关注。 就绝对值而言,安全/毒性评价很少——只有大约25个数据集的语言行——而且这些评价几乎完全集中在更高的资源水平上,这意味着实际上不存在低资源语言的安全覆盖。 图8(附录)对照世界各区域交叉划分任务类别,并证实质量保证和知识任务在各地占主导地位,而专门能力显示覆盖面不均衡。 这种任务公平差距意味着,对于大多数资源低的语文来说,一个模型的 " 评价 " 相当于对翻译和分类的狭义探究,使其过于局限于支持一般能力的要求。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Task coverage by resource level. Each cell shows the percentage of a resource level’s dataset–language rows devoted to that task category. Left-Behinds are overwhelmingly evaluated on Translation (29%) and Sentiment/Classification (25%); specialised tasks such as Coding, Safety, Instruction Following, each account for ≤ \leq 1% of their evaluation, whereas Winners are evaluated more evenly across all 15 categories.
blocks.zh: 图3:按资源水平划分的任务覆盖面。 每个单元格都显示资源级数据集-用于该任务类别的语言行的百分比。 在翻译(29%)和感官/分类(25%)方面,对左后方的评价占绝大多数;诸如编码、安全、指令跟踪等专门任务占评价的1%,而胜者的评价在所有15个类别中更为均匀。

blocks.en: The coverage analysis reveals an ecosystem that is wide but thin : many languages are nominally included, but the depth of evaluation measured by replication across datasets, typological diversity, task breadth, and resource-level balance is concentrated in a small core. The next section asks whether the quality of coverage that does exist is adequate.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面分析揭示了一种广泛但很薄的生态系统:名义上包含了许多语言,但通过跨数据集复制、类型多样性、任务宽度和资源水平平衡来衡量的评价深度集中在一个小核心。 下一节询问是否存在适当的覆盖质量。

blocks.en: 3.2 Representativeness
blocks.zh: 3.2 代表性

blocks.en: Coverage establishes what is evaluated; representativeness asks whether that evaluation is valid . A dataset may nominally cover a language, yet evaluate it using content translated from English, written by non-native speakers, or detached from local cultural context and assumptions. We audit the 242 datasets along two axes: translation and cultural grounding. At the dataset–language level, 56% of all instances are translated from English, 36% are natively authored, and 8% are partially adapted.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面确定了评价的内容;代表性问题在于评价是否有效。 数据集名义上可能涵盖一种语言,但使用从英语翻译、非母语者撰写或脱离当地文化背景和假设的内容对它进行评价。 我们审计242个数据集,沿着两个轴线:翻译和文化定位。 在数据集-语言层面,56%的案例是英文翻译的,36%是本地作者,8%是部分改编的。

blocks.en: Translation vs. Native Construction: The dominant construction strategy for multilingual datasets remains translation from English source datasets. This approach scales efficiently as one annotation effort produces content in many languages but comes with the cost of translationese artifacts, English-centric framing, and inherited contamination risk (Section 3.3 ) ( Artetxe et al., 2020a ; Graham et al., 2020 ) . Figure 4(a) disaggregates translation status by world region. In every region, a substantial fraction of languages are evaluated primarily through translated content. Datasets covering Europe and East Asia are the most translation-dependent, while Sub-Saharan Africa shows the highest share of natively authored content, which is a direct consequence of language-specific datasets created from scratch such as AfroBench ( Ojo et al., 2025 ) , IrokoBench Adelani et al. (2025) , and MasakhaNER ( Adelani et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 翻译与土著建筑: 多语种数据集的主要构建策略仍然是从英语源数据集翻译. 这种方法由于一项注解努力以多种语言产生内容而得到高效的衡量,但随着翻译文物的成本、以英语为中心的框架以及继承的污染风险(第3.3节)(Artetxe等人,2020a;Graham等人,2020年)。 在每个区域,大部分语文主要通过翻译内容加以评价。 覆盖欧洲和东亚的数据集最依赖翻译,而撒哈拉以南非洲的本土著作内容所占比例最高,这是从零开始创建的语言专用数据集的直接结果,如African Bench(Ojo等人,2025年),Iroko Bench Adelani等人(2025年)和Masakhaner(Adelani等人,2021年)。

blocks.en: Cultural Representativeness: Culturally grounded datasets reflect the norms, knowledge, and pragmatic conventions of the target language community. A dataset can be natively authored yet culturally shallow (e.g., factoid QA drawn from Wikipedia), and a translated dataset can incorporate cultural adaptation (transcreation) to make it more culturally grounded. However, in practice, the two are correlated: datasets constructed from scratch by native-speaker communities are far more likely to be culturally grounded. Figure 4(b) shows cultural grounding rates by region. Datasets targeting Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia exhibit the highest cultural grounding rates, reflecting the deliberate design philosophy of community-driven efforts like CulturalBench ( Chiu et al., 2025 ) , Samiksha Hamna et al. (2026) , and TUMLU ( Isbarov et al., 2025 ) . By contrast, datasets with broad cross-regional scope tend to have lower cultural grounding as it is difficult to achieve at scale. This finding reinforces the pattern: the datasets that are methodologically strongest along the representativeness axis are those with the narrowest language coverage.
blocks.zh: 文化代表性:基于文化的数据集反映了目标语言群体的规范、知识和实用惯例。 数据集可以由本地作者编写,但文化浅析(例如,从维基百科中提取的事实QA),翻译数据集可以包含文化适应(transcreation),使其更具有文化基础. 然而,在实践中,两者是相互关联的:由讲土著语的社区从零开始构建的数据集更可能基于文化。 图4(b)显示按区域分列的文化基数。 以撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚为对象的数据集显示的文化定位率最高,反映了诸如Cultural Bench(Chiu等人,2025年),Samiksha等社区努力的精心设计理念。 Hamna等人(2026年)和TUMLU(Isbarov等人,2025年)。 相比之下,具有广泛跨区域范围的数据集往往文化基础较低,因为难以大规模实现。 这一发现加强了模式:在代表性轴上方法最强的数据集是语言覆盖范围最窄的数据集。

blocks.en: Annotator Demographics: Transparency around annotation workforces remains limited: only 8 of 51 benchmarks (16%) report annotator demographics such as geographic origin, ethnicity, or educational background, and only 17 (33%) disclose compensation details. Researchers are the dominant creator type across datasets, with community volunteers and crowdworkers accounting for a small minority, raising questions about whose linguistic backgrounds and priorities shape “ground truth” for underrepresented languages. The few benchmarks that do document their annotation pipeline in detail (CulturalBench, Aya, and Uhuru) tend to be the same ones that score highest on cultural grounding, suggesting that annotator transparency and evaluation validity go hand in hand.
blocks.zh: 统计: 关于注解劳动力的透明度仍然有限:51个基准中只有8个基准(16%)报告注解人员的人口统计,如地理出身、族裔或教育背景,只有17个基准(33%)披露了赔偿细节。 研究人员是各种数据集中占主导地位的创造者,社区志愿人员和人群工作者占少数,从而提出了由谁的语言背景和优先事项决定代表性不足语言的“基本真相”的问题。 详细记录其注解管道的少数基准(Cultural Bench、Aya和Uhuru)往往是在文化基础方面得分最高的基准,表明注解者的透明度和评价有效性是同时存在的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Rigor
blocks.zh: 3.3 严格

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Metrics

Metrics determine what counts as success, and poorly chosen metrics can give a misleading picture of model quality. Most benchmarks rely either on standard reference-based metrics to compare model outputs against ground truth, or on reference-free metrics such as LLM judges. However, many widely used metrics, such as BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, and Word Error Rate, were developed largely in English-centric settings and can be poor proxies for quality in morphologically rich languages or languages with non-standard spellings, where valid responses may differ substantially in surface form. Similarly, although LLM judges are increasingly becoming standard in evaluation pipelines, prior work shows that they often align poorly with human judgments in multilingual and multicultural settings, particularly for low-resource languages and in culturally grounded, context-sensitive evaluations ( Hada et al., 2024b ; Watts et al., 2024 ; Hamna et al., 2026 ; Hada et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: 衡量标准确定什么是成功,选择不当的衡量标准可以对模型质量产生误导。 大多数基准要么依靠基于标准参考的衡量标准来比较模型产出与地面真实性,要么依靠LLM法官等无参考的衡量标准。 然而,许多被广泛使用的度量衡,如BLEU,ROUGE,精确匹配,以及Word Error rate,大多是在以英语为中心的环境中开发的,在形态丰富的语言或有非标准拼写语言中,对于质量来说可能是差的代词,在表层形式上,有效的响应可能有很大的差异. 同样,虽然LLM法官越来越成为评价程序的标准,但先前的工作表明,他们往往与多种语言和多文化环境中的人类判断不一致,特别是对资源低的语言和基于文化背景的评价(Hada等人,2024年b;Watts等人,2024年;Hamna等人,2026年;Hada等人,2024年a ) 。

blocks.en: Contamination is especially consequential in multilingual evaluation because much of the evaluation ecosystem is thin : 36% of languages appear in only one dataset (Figure 1 ), and 56% of dataset–language rows rely on translated content (Figure 4(a) ). When a language’s evaluation rests on a single translated dataset, contamination through any pathway invalidates the only evidence of model competence for that language. The task equity gap (Figure 3 ) further amplifies this risk: for low-resource languages evaluated on only 1–2 task categories, contamination on even a single task can dominate the reported result.
blocks.zh: 污染在多语种评价中尤其具有后果,因为大部分评价生态系统很薄:36%的语言只出现在一个数据集(图1)中,56%的数据集-语言行依赖翻译内容(图4(a))。 当一种语言的评价依赖于一个单一的翻译数据集时,通过任何途径造成的污染都会使该语言模式能力的唯一证据失效。 任务公平差距(图3)进一步加大了这一风险:对于仅对1至2个任务类别进行评价的低资源语言而言,即使是单一任务的污染也可能主宰报告的结果。

blocks.en: Prior Contamination Analyses. Several studies have investigated multilingual benchmark contamination using surface-form overlap and membership inference methods. Ahuja et al. (2024a) found that GPT-4, Llama-2, and Gemini-Pro are likely contaminated on PAWS-X, XCopa, and XQuAD. Ahuja et al. (2024b) extended this analysis to newer models (Llama-3.1, Mistral-v0.3, Gemma-2) and confirmed pervasive contamination across 7 benchmarks. Yao et al. (2024) further demonstrated that contamination transfers cross-lingually : models contaminated on the English version of a dataset show inflated scores on non-English translations (Table 3 , Appendix). Aggregating across these studies, 9 of the 10 models tested are contaminated on PAWS-X, XCopa, and XQuAD, and 7 of 7 are contaminated on Flores (Table 1 ; per-model details in Table 2 , Appendix). However, these analyses examined a limited set of established datasets, leaving open the question of whether contamination extends to newer evaluation suites.
blocks.zh: 前污染分析. 一些研究利用表面形式重叠和成员推论方法调查了多种语文基准污染。 Ahuja等人(2024年a)发现,GPT-4、Llama-2和双子公司可能污染PAWS-X、XCopa和QQuAD。 Ahuja等人(2024年b)将这一分析扩展至较新的模型(Llama-3.1,Mistral-v0.3,Gemma-2),并证实在7个基准中存在普遍的污染。 姚等编. (2024年)进一步证明,污染通过多种语言进行转移:一个数据集的英文版显示,非英文译文的分数被污染的模型(表3,附录)。 在这些研究中,经过测试的10种模型中有9种在PAWS-X、XCopa和XuAD上受到污染,7种模型中有7种在Flores上受到污染(表1;附录表2中的模型细节)。 然而,这些分析研究了一套有限的既定数据集,对污染是否扩大到较新的评价套间的问题留有定论。

blocks.en: Contamination Analysis with STAMP. To provide an updated assessment, we apply STAMP ( Rastogi et al., 2025 ) to a broader and more contemporary suite of 9 datasets including recent ones such as Global MMLU, MILU, INCLUDE, and IndicParam alongside established ones like PAWS-X, MGSM, and AfriMGSM across 7 recent models (Table 4 , Appendix). STAMP makes minimal assumptions about data format, enabling reliable membership detection at trace levels while strictly preserving the semantic meaning and evaluation utility of the original content. Following Rastogi et al. (2025) , we operationalize contamination detection by generating 9 paraphrased versions of each dataset item and measuring the performance gap between the original and its variants. Paraphrases are produced using Qwen-3.5 397B , a large multilingual model chosen because its scale ensures high-quality rephrasings across diverse writing systems. Our results reveal that contamination remains pervasive for older datasets: PAWS-X (67.9% of model–language pairs flagged), MGSM (45.5%), and AfriMGSM (21.0%) show significant contamination signals across all seven models (Table 1 ). By contrast, newer datasets—MILU (0.0%), INCLUDE (1.0%), and Global MMLU (1.7%) exhibit markedly lower contamination rates, suggesting that dataset age and prominence are strong predictors of contamination risk. One notable discrepancy emerges for Flores : prior surface-form methods flag 7 of 7 models, yet STAMP detects contamination in only 1.2% of model–language pairs. This divergence likely reflects differences in what each method measures, i.e. surface-form overlap versus memorization-driven performance gaps and underscores that no single detection approach suffices for multilingual contamination.
blocks.zh: 与STAMP的污染分析. 为了提供最新的评估,我们将STAMP(Rastogi等人,2025年)应用于一个范围更广、更现代的9套数据集,包括最近的一些数据集,如全球MMLU、MILU、INCLUDE和Indicaram,以及PAWS-X、MGSM和AfriMGSM等已有的数据集,涵盖7个最新模型(附录,表4)。 STAMP对数据格式作出最小的假设,在微量水平上能够可靠地检测成员,同时严格保留原始内容的语义意义和评价效用. 继Rastogi等人(2025年)之后,我们通过生成每个数据集的9个简化版本并测量原始数据与其变体之间的性能差距,对污染进行探测。 参数使用Quen-3.5 397B制作,这是一个选择的大型多语种模型,因为其规模确保了不同书写系统的高质量重写。 我们的结果显示,对旧的数据集来说,污染仍然很普遍:PAWS-X(67.9%的型号-语言对标)、MGSM(45.5%)和AfriMGSM(21.0%)在所有七个模型中都显示出明显的污染信号(表1)。 相比之下,较新的数据集——MILU(0.0%)、INCLUDE(1.0%)和全球MMLU(1.7%)的污染率明显较低,这表明数据集的年代和突出程度是预测污染风险的有力指标。 Flores 出现了一个明显的差异:以前的表面形态方法标出7种模型中的7种,然而STAMP检测到的污染只有1.2 %的型号-语言配对. 这种差异可能反映了每种方法衡量方法的不同,即表面形态重叠与记忆驱动的性能差距,并强调,任何单一的检测方法都不足以造成多种语言的污染。

blocks.en: Complementary Analysis with DCQ. We additionally apply the Data Contamination Quiz (DCQ) Golchin and Surdeanu (2025) to 85 dataset–language partitions from 8 datasets across the same 7 models. For each of 100 sampled items per partition, GPT-4.1 produces four word-level synonym perturbations. A bias-detection quiz first presents only the four perturbations and a “none of these” option; the original item is then inserted into positions that the model under-selected in this initial quiz. Selecting the verbatim original provides a recognition signal while the initial responses estimate positional bias. DCQ reports a conservative and a maximum recognition rate; we use the maximum rate in Table 1 for consistency across models, while noting that taking the best rate across positions is optimistic and that 20% is the random-chance floor. At the dataset level, PAWS-X (32.6%) and MGSM (30.9%) show the strongest average recognition, whereas the remaining dataset averages range from 14.7% to 21.7%. Recognition is generally higher for English partitions: for example, English versus non-English averages are 45.7% versus 15.3% for AfriMGSM, 44.0% versus 29.6% for MGSM, and 47.6% versus 30.1% for PAWS-X. These values measure recognition rather than the fraction of a dataset that leaked and should not be directly equated with STAMP’s significance-based flag rate. Full dataset–model results, language-group comparisons, and validity caveats are reported in Appendix B.1 .

DCQ报告一个保守和最大识别率;我们使用表1中的最高识别率来表示模型的一致性,同时指出,在位置上采取最佳识别率是乐观的,20%是随机跳动下限. 在数据集层面,PAWS-X(32.6%)和MGSM(30.9%)显示最强的平均识别率,而其余数据集平均值从14.7%到21.7%。 英语分区的识别率一般较高:例如,英语相对于非英语的平均水平为45.7%,而AfriMGSM为15.3%,MGSM为44.0%,而MGSM为29.6%,PAWS-X为47.6%,而30.1%. 这些值衡量识别,而不是一个数据组中漏出并且不应直接等同于STAMP基于意义旗帜率的部分。 完整的数据集-模型结果、语言组比较和有效性说明载于附录B.1。

blocks.en: Challenges of Multilingual Contamination Detection. Both STAMP and DCQ rely on another LLM to construct the measuring instrument, so variation in that model’s competence across languages can be mistaken for variation in contamination. For STAMP, semantically faithful watermarked rephrasing is harder across typologically distant and low-resource languages; uneven paraphrase quality introduces noise into the paired test. Its KGW watermarking scheme also partitions vocabulary through a tokenizer-dependent hash function ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) , so sparse or unstable tokenization can weaken the watermark and the test’s statistical power. For DCQ, difficulty is determined by the quality of GPT-4.1’s decoys. Perturbation distance ranges from 5.8% for AfriMGSM in Amharic to 48.1% for Global MMLU in English and varies with language resource level. In the eight weakest partitions, decoys are too similar to the original for reliable separation, pinning recognition near the chance floor regardless of exposure; conversely, misspellings or semantic drift can make decoys easier to reject and inflate recognition. This asymmetry is especially consequential because it can reproduce the expected finding: apparently lower contamination in low-resource languages may reflect a weaker measuring instrument rather than less exposure.
blocks.zh: 多语种污染检测挑战. STAMP和DCQ都依赖另一种LLM来构建测量仪器,因此该模型不同语言之间能力的差异可能被误认为是污染的变化。 对STAMP来说,在类型遥远且资源少的语言中,标注在水的精密重写比较困难;不均匀的译文质量将噪声引入配对测试中. 其KGW的标注计划也通过一个依赖标注器的散列函数(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年)来分割词汇,因此稀疏或不稳定的标注会削弱标注和测试的统计力. 对于DCQ来说,难度是由GPT-4.1的诱饵的质量决定的. 扰动距离从阿姆哈拉语的AfriMGSM的5.8%到英语的Global MMLU的48.1%不等,并随语言资源水平的不同而变化. 在八个最弱的分区中,诱饵太像原始的,无法可靠地分离,不论接触与否,都会在机会底附近钉住识别;反之,误打或语义漂移会使诱饵更容易拒绝和放大识别. 这种不对称尤其具有后果,因为它可以复制预期的发现:资源低的语言显然污染较小,可能反映一种较弱的测量仪器,而不是较少暴露。

blocks.en: DCQ introduces a further identification problem because its prompt names the dataset, potentially conflating recognition of the dataset label with recognition of its instances. Our natural replicate holds all 100 GSM8K items byte-identical while changing only the label from AfriMGSM to MGSM; the resulting recognition difference ranges from 1 percentage point for Aya-Expanse-8B to 23 points for Gemma-3-12B (Appendix B.1 ). This variation cannot be attributed to contamination and limits how finely models or languages can be compared. Removing the dataset name would reduce the confound but also remove a cue on which DCQ’s recognition design depends. Together, these limitations show that neither method is language-neutral: multilingual contamination claims require per-language instrument validation and convergence across complementary methods rather than direct comparison of raw scores.
blocks.zh: DCQ提出了另一个识别问题,因为其即时命名数据集,可能将数据集标签的识别与其实例的识别混为一谈。 我们的自然复制持有所有100个GSM8K项目字节相同,同时只将标签从AfriMGSM改为MGSM;由此产生的识别差从Aya-Expanse-8B的1个百分点到Gemma-3-12B的23个百分点(附录B.1 )不等. 这种变化不能归因于污染,并限制了如何精确地比较模型或语言。 删除数据集名称将减少混乱, 但也删除DCQQs识别设计所依赖的提示 。 这些限制加在一起表明,这两种方法都不是语言中立的:多语种污染索赔需要每种语言的仪器验证和各种互补方法的趋同,而不是直接比较原始分数。

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Reporting Practices in Model Releases
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 模型发布中的报告做法

blocks.en: Based on our analysis, we ask: how do model developers report multilingual evaluation? We audit 23 recent model releases (15 open-weight, 8 closed-models, 2024–2026) across five binary transparency dimensions (1) whether training language composition is explicitly disclosed, (2) whether any multilingual evaluation dataset/benchmark is reported, (3) whether the specific evaluation languages are listed, (4) whether a contamination detection technique is named, and (5) whether contamination results are reported. The composite transparency score is the sum (0–5) (Figure 12 ; full methodology and per-model breakdown in Appendix A.7 ). The results are stark: 35% of releases report zero multilingual datasets, and 87% provide no contamination analysis. Only 3 models (all open-weight) report any contamination testing, and even these leave cross-lingual contamination pathways unexamined. When multilingual evaluation is reported, it concentrates on a handful of benchmarks, the model–dataset matrix is 93% sparse, while natively authored datasets from our survey (AfroBench, IrokoBench, MILU) are almost entirely unused. Open-weight models are more transparent (mean score 2.47/5) than closed (0.75/5), but both fall well below adequacy: the overall mean is 1.87/5, and no closed model discloses training language composition or reports contamination. These findings argue for a standardized multilingual evaluation card mandating per-language dataset disclosure accounting for contamination. Finally, multilingual safety evaluation is reported by only 4 of 23 models: Tiny Aya, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and CommandA. All other models either test safety only in English or do not report safety testing at all.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets reveals a consistent pattern across all three pillars. Coverage is wide but thin: 36% of languages appear in only a single dataset and entire regions of the world are completely absent. Multilingual safety datasets remain few in number and provide little coverage of low-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: the datasets with the broadest language coverage are the most translated and least culturally grounded, while the most valid datasets cover the fewest languages. Annotator demographics are rarely reported, with researchers being the primary data creators of multilingual datasets, raising concerns about whose values and priorities are reflected in these datasets. Rigor is undermined by multiple contamination pathways that are amplified by translation-based construction, English-centric metrics that do not always work well on diverse languages and a lack of meaningful reporting of multilingual evaluation in model releases. These findings point to a systemic misalignment between how multilingual evaluation is currently conducted and what it would need to be to support trustworthy claims of cross-lingual competence. If these issues are not taken seriously, multilingual evaluation risks becoming performative: creating the appearance of inclusion while masking shallow support, overstating progress, and ultimately widening existing linguistic and cultural gaps in AI.
blocks.zh: 我们对涵盖242个数据集的51个最近多语种基准的审计显示,所有三个支柱都有一贯的模式。 覆盖面很广,但很薄:36%的语言只出现在一个数据集中,而整个世界完全不存在。 多语种安全数据集数量仍然很少,对低资源语言的覆盖也很少。 代表性在结构上受到损害:语言覆盖面最广的数据集翻译最多,文化基础最少,而最有效的数据集覆盖最少数语言. 很少报告注释者的人口统计,研究人员是多语种数据集的主要数据创造者,这引起了人们对数据集中反映哪些价值观和优先事项的关切。 限制因多种污染途径而受损,这些途径因翻译结构而扩大,以英语为中心的衡量标准在多种语言上并不总是行之有效,在模型发布中缺乏对多语种评价的有意义的报告。 这些结论表明,目前如何进行多语种评价与需要何种评价来支持可信的跨语种能力主张之间存在着系统性的错位。 如果不认真对待这些问题,多语种评价就有可能产生效果:造成包容的外表,同时掩盖浅薄的支持,夸大进展,最终扩大大赦国际现有的语言和文化差距。

blocks.en: Supporting a language is not simply a matter of translating prompts, reporting a score, or listing it in a benchmark; it requires evidence that the system works in ways that are meaningful for users in their local linguistic and cultural contexts. Similarly, evaluating a language is not just measuring in another language what was originally defined in English, but assessing model behavior under the norms, knowledge systems, communicative practices, and risks that shape real use. Our work aims to raise the bar for how multilingual evaluation is conducted and reported. Reporting should make clear what was evaluated, how data was created or adapted, what contexts are covered, and what claims the results do and do not support. Meaningful community participation must go beyond translation or validation to include communities in defining tasks, rubrics, and failure modes. AI itself can also help scale multilingual evaluation through advances in multilingual synthetic data ( Chitale et al., 2026 ) , aligned multilingual LLM judges, and dynamic benchmarks to avoid contamination. Multilingual evaluation must also move beyond model-level assessment to include product, user, and real-world impact evaluation 7 7 7 https://eval.playbook.org.ai/ , since model performance alone cannot capture how systems behave in deployed, culturally situated settings.
blocks.zh: 支持一种语言不仅仅是翻译提示、报告得分或将它列入基准的问题;它要求有证据表明,该系统的运作方式对用户在当地语言和文化背景下有意义。 同样,评估一种语言不仅仅是用另一种语言衡量最初在英语中定义的内容,而是评估规范下的模型行为、知识系统、交流做法以及塑造实际使用的风险。 我们的工作的目的是提高律师资格,说明如何进行和报告多语种评价。 报告应明确评估的内容、数据是如何创建或调整的、涵盖哪些背景、以及哪些结果是否得到支持。 有意义的社区参与必须超越翻译或验证,让社区参与确定任务、标题和失败模式。 AI本身也可以通过多语种合成数据的进步(Chitale等人,2026年),调和多语种LLM评委,以及动态基准以避免污染来帮助扩大多语种评价的规模. 多语种评价还必须超越模型层面的评估,将产品、用户和现实世界的影响评价纳入其中。 7 7 7 https://eval.playbook.org.ai/,因为单靠模型性能无法掌握系统在已部署的、文化背景环境中的表现。

blocks.en: There is an inherent tension between coverage and representativeness in multilingual evaluation: approaches that scale across many languages often depend on standardization, while representativeness requires deeper engagement with local variation, context, and heterogeneity. If the field is committed to supporting everyone with AI, it must accept this tension as a fundamental reality: meaningful evaluation cannot always be reduced to uniform or fully replicable patterns across highly diverse settings, and some degree of variation must be expected as a consequence of taking linguistic, cultural, and contextual diversity seriously.
blocks.zh: 多语种评价的覆盖面和代表性之间有着内在的紧张关系:在很多语言中推广的方法往往取决于标准化,而代表性则要求更深入地接触地方差异、背景和异性。 如果该领域致力于支持每个人使用人工智能,就必须接受这种紧张关系为基本现实:不能总是将有意义的评价降低到高度多样化环境中的统一或完全可复制的格局,而且由于认真对待语言、文化和背景多样性,必须预计会出现一定程度的差异。

blocks.en: A.1 Data Extraction Methodology
blocks.zh: A.1 数据提取 方法

blocks.en: We survey 51 multilingual evaluation benchmarks and extract structured metadata at dataset-level granularity through a multi-step pipeline. For each benchmark/dataset paper, Claude Opus 4.6 extracts the constituent datasets, their member languages, and three key properties per dataset: whether the evaluation content was translated from another language (typically English), whether native speakers were involved in annotation, and whether the dataset is culturally grounded in the target locale rather than reflecting source-culture assumptions. The extraction operates at a three-level hierarchy—benchmark → \rightarrow dataset → \rightarrow language. Language metadata is enriched deterministically from authoritative sources: family and macroarea, primary script from Glottolog 8 8 8 https://glottolog.org/meta/downloads , and resource classification (levels 0–5) from Joshi et al. (2020) ’s taxonomy. To avoid inflated counts from shared datasets appearing across multiple aggregation benchmarks, we deduplicate at the (dataset, language) level while retaining benchmark provenance. Each property is assessed at the dataset level with an associated confidence rating (high, medium, or low) and a supporting evidence passage extracted from the paper. These produced assessments are then surfaced in a web-based human review interface (Figure 5 ), where reviewers inspect the extracted values and evidence, verify or correct language membership through interactive toggles, and provide final judgments via structured dropdowns. Certain datasets are automatically flagged for mandatory review due to missing or uncertain property values (e.g., unknown native annotator status), indicated by colored needs review badges.

blocks.en: Figure 10 reveals how translation status interacts with resource level. Across all resource levels, roughly 35–40% of dataset–language instances involve native data. However, the composition shifts at the extremes: Left-Behinds ( n = 178 n=178 ) have the lowest native share ( ∼ 20 % {\sim}20\% ) and are overwhelmingly evaluated through translated datasets, while Winners ( n = 360 n=360 ) maintain a higher native proportion ( ∼ 40 % {\sim}40\% ) but still rely heavily on translated data. This pattern suggests that the most under-served languages are also the most likely to be evaluated using data that does not originate from their speech communities.

Central Asia and South Asia have the highest native-annotator share ( ∼ 50 % {\sim}50\% ), driven by dedicated regional datasets/benchmarks (e.g., IndicGenBench, INCLUDE). blocks.en: We examine technical reports, model cards, and blog posts for 23 model releases spanning 2024–2026 (15 open-weight, 8 closed-models). Each release is scored on five binary transparency dimensions: (1) whether training language composition is explicitly disclosed, (2) whether any multilingual evaluation datasets is reported, (3) whether the specific evaluation languages are listed, (4) whether a contamination detection technique is named, and (5) whether contamination results are reported. The composite transparency score is the sum (0–5).
blocks.zh: 包括2024年到2026年的23个版本(15个开放量级,8个封闭型)。 每次发布均在五个二进制透明度维度上得分:(1)培训语言成分是否明确披露,(2)是否报告任何多语种评价数据集,(3)是否列出特定评价语言,(4)是否命名污染检测技术,(5)是否报告污染结果. 复合透明分数是总和(0–5).

blocks.en: include GPT, Grok, Mistral 3, BharatGen, Command-R+, OLMo, and Kimi K2.5. Kimi K2.5, for example, is described by its authors as “very English centric.” Similarly, while Sarvam is trained on 22 Indian languages, its reported evaluation appears to center on a newly introduced dataset/benchmark scored using an LLM judge, without corresponding results on other widely used multilingual datasets. Consequently, the multilingual capabilities of these releases remain difficult to verify comprehensively, given the limited publicly reported evaluation evidence.
blocks.zh: 包括GPT,Grok,Mistral 3,BharatGen,Command-R+,OLMo,和Kimi K2.5. 例如,Kimi K2.5被作者描述为“非常以英语为中心”。 同样,虽然Sarvam接受过22种印度语言的培训,但所报告的评价似乎以使用LLM法官的新引入数据集/基准得分为中心,对其他广泛使用的多语种数据集没有相应的结果。 因此,鉴于公开报告的评价证据有限,这些释放的多种语文能力仍然难以全面核实。

blocks.en: Open-weight models average 2.47/5 on the transparency score vs. 0.75/5 for closed models. blocks.en:
We apply the Data Contamination Quiz (DCQ) (

Table 6 compares English partitions with the mean over non-English partitions where both are available. Because each quiz has five options, 20% is the random-chance floor. 我们采用数据污染查询(DCQ)(

blocks.en: Eight partitions have perturbation distance below 10%, making their quizzes close to unsolvable and their low scores uninformative. The bias-detection abstention rate is also near zero for most models, indicating that models often guess rather than select “none of these.” A byte-identical replicate of the English GSM8K items under the AfriMGSM and MGSM dataset names produces a mean absolute difference of 9.7 percentage points and a maximum difference of 23 points across models. Individual DCQ values should therefore be treated as approximate.

blocks.en: Appendix C Released Resources and Interactive Dashboard
blocks.zh: 附录C 资源与互动盘

blocks.en: To facilitate community engagement with these findings, we will release three resources upon acceptance. First, we will provide the structured metadata annotations for all 51 benchmarks and 242 datasets, including per-language fields for script, language family, resource level, task categories, translation status, native annotator provenance, and cultural grounding. Second, we will release the full analysis codebase used to produce all figures, tables, and statistics in this paper, enabling researchers to reproduce our analysis and extend it as new datasets appear. Third, we provide an interactive web dashboard that allows users to explore coverage and representativeness statistics, browse individual datasets via a searchable explorer, and look up per-language dataset coverage. The dashboard is designed to be a living resource that will be updated as new datasets are added to the survey.
blocks.zh: 为了促进社区参与这些调查结果,我们将在接受后释放三笔资源。 首先,我们将为所有51个基准和242个数据集提供结构化元数据说明,包括脚本、语言家族、资源水平、任务类别、翻译状况、本土注释来源和文化基础的每个语文字段。 第二,我们将发布本文中用于生成所有数字、表格和统计的完整分析编码库,使研究人员能够复制我们的分析,并在新的数据集出现时加以扩展。 第三,我们提供一个互动网络仪表板,使用户能够探索覆盖面和代表性统计,通过可搜索的探索器浏览单个数据集,并查询每个语言数据集的覆盖面。 仪表板的设计是一种生物资源,将在调查中加入新的数据集后加以更新。
